commission: Create a deterministic notification-first attention statement compiler whose notification alone contains the complete action and whose resolved state emits no alarm.
acceptanceCriteria: Identical event input returns identical notification text.
The imperative action precedes verified fact and theatrical sting.
Explicit pulse changes repeat wording deterministically without randomness.
Resolved state returns null and cannot emit the old alarm.
Overlong critical clauses fail rather than silently truncating the required action.
Gmail, Home Center main failure, and Phone Hands disconnect fixtures exercise distinct attention targets.
